# Benzinga-shaped RSS test data

**THIS IS BENZINGA-SHAPED TEST DATA. IT IS NOT A COPY OF BENZINGA'S
PROPRIETARY FEED OR A CLAIM OF SCHEMA COMPATIBILITY.**

The XML files in this directory contain fictional financial-news items used
only to exercise the deterministic Milestone 1 parser and normalizer. The
initial shape remains provisional until a representative stakeholder feed is
available and reviewed.
